content.text:
The correct answer is A. The article 283 of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China stipulates: "For matters such as the apportionment of expenses and distribution of income of buildings and their ancillary facilities, if there is an agreement, the agreement shall be followed; if there is no agreement or the agreement is unclear, the apportionment shall be determined according to the proportion of the exclusive part area of the owners."
